pool.text: Jatavarman Sundara Pandyan brought the region under the Pandya rule.
A Vijayanagara-era inscription mentions the port of Mādarasanpattanam.
The Portuguese arrived and built the port of São Tomé.
The Dutch established themselves near Pulicat to the north.
The British East India Company obtained a grant for coastal land.
Madras Bank was established as the first European-style bank.
Madras Music Season was initiated by the Madras Music Academy.
A suburban railway network operated by Southern railway was established.
Madras University introduced a course of music in curriculum.
Madras became the capital city of the Madras State after independence.
Potti Sreeramulu's hunger strike resulted in the formation of Andhra State.
The completion of the LIC Building marked a structural transition.
Agitations against the imposition of Hindi arose in the city.
A split in the DMK resulted in the formation of AIADMK.
State Express Transport Corporation Limited was established to run long distance express services.
The city of Madras was officially renamed as Chennai by the government.
Tidel Park was established as an early and large IT park.
A tsunami lashed the shores of Chennai and killed people.
Chennai has a total of 120 cinema screens and multiplexes operating.
Chennai was ranked among National Geographic's top food cities.
